summary: Universal Logistics Holdings (ULH) indirectly sold a Kearny, NJ facility for $38M cash and simultaneously acquired all membership interests of Passaic Ventures LLC (owner of Newark, NJ facility) from Lakeshore Ventures LLC in a related-party transaction approved by disinterested directors. The Kearny REPA and Passaic MIPA were executed June 24, 2026. No premium, share price, or break fee stated. The buyer/swap partner is affiliated with ULH's Chairman and a director, requiring independent committee oversight. What to watch: potential minority shareholder scrutiny of the valuations and any related-party fairness opinion.
